<style id="v1vy-redesign">/* V1VY personal blog redesign */

#content>div:first-child{max-width:640px;margin:0 0 34px!important;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.8}#content>div:first-child:before{display:block;margin-bottom:13px;color:var(--blue);content:"NOTES FROM V1VY";font:700 11px/1.2 "Segoe UI",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em}
.SideNav{display:grid;gap:13px;min-width:0;overflow:visible;border:0!important;background:transparent}.SideNav-item{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;min-height:112px;padding:25px 27px!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)!important;text-decoration:none!important;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.SideNav-item:hover{z-index:1;transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--blue)!important;box-shadow:0 18px 42px #18212c12}.SideNav-item>.d-flex{min-width:0;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:17px}.SideNav-icon{flex:none;width:27px!important;height:27px!important;margin:3px 0 0!important;padding:6px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue)}.listTitle{overflow:visible;max-width:unset;white-space:normal;text-overflow:clip;font-size:19px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.025em}.listLabels{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:6px}.listLabels .Label{margin:0;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--soft)!important;color:var(--blue)!important;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}.listLabels .Label a{color:inherit!important;text-decoration:none}.listLabels .LabelTime{background:transparent!important;color:var(--muted)!important;font:500 12px/1.4 "Segoe UI",sans-serif}.Label object{max-width:none;max-height:none}
#footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:56px;padding:19px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-align:left}#footer a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}#footer2{display:flex;gap:10px}#footer2 span:empty{display:none}
body:has(#postBody){max-width:960px}body:has(#postBody) #header{align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:38px}.postTitle{max-width:760px;margin:0;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,42px)!important;line-height:1.28;letter-spacing:-.045em}#postBody{padding:0 0 45px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:var(--ink);font-size:17px;line-height:1.9}#postBody>*{max-width:780px}#postBody h1,#postBody h2,#postBody h3{margin-top:1.8em;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.035em}#postBody h2{padding-bottom:.45em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}#postBody p{margin:1.1em 0}#postBody img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px}#postBody blockquote{margin:1.5em 0;padding:4px 22px;border-left:3px solid var(--blue);background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted)}#postBody pre{overflow:auto;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);font-size:14px;line-height:1.65}#cmButton{height:auto;min-height:48px;margin-top:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
body:has(.tagTitle) .tagTitle{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.04em}body:has(.tagTitle) .SideNav-item{min-height:90px}#taglabel{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:24px!important}#taglabel .Label{margin:0;padding:9px 13px!important;border:0;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}#taglabel .Counter{margin-left:5px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:99px;background:#ffffff35;color:inherit}body:has(.tagTitle) .subnav-search{display:flex;gap:0;width:auto}body:has(.tagTitle) .subnav-search-input{width:min(220px,45vw);height:40px!important;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px 0 0 8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}body:has(.tagTitle) .subnav-search button{padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:0;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}.notFind{color:var(--muted)}:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #315bdf9e;outline-offset:3px}

/* V2: yellow new-brutalist portfolio */
:root{--paper:#ffd83d;--surface:#fffdf5;--ink:#151515;--muted:#45423a;--line:#151515;--blue:#214dd8;--soft:#dce5ff;--shadow:7px 7px 0 #151515;color-scheme:light}
html[data-color-mode=dark]{--paper:#f0c928;--surface:#252525;--ink:#fffdf5;--muted:#d2cdbd;--line:#090909;--blue:#a9bcff;--soft:#30394f;color-scheme:dark}
html,body{background:var(--paper)}
body{max-width:1280px;padding:28px 54px 34px;font-family:"Arial Narrow","Segoe UI","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif}
#header{min-height:70px;padding:0 0 15px;margin-bottom:35px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--ink)}
.avatar{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink)}
.title-left .blogTitle{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.title-right .circle{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0!important;color:var(--ink)}
.title-right .circle:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
#content>div:first-child{max-width:720px;color:var(--ink);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.65}
#content>div:first-child:before{color:var(--ink);content:"V1VY / WORKS ARCHIVE";font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em}
.portfolio-hero{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 225px;gap:28px;align-items:end;margin:0 0 42px;padding:38px 42px 34px;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.portfolio-hero:after{position:absolute;top:15px;right:16px;width:56px;height:56px;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:radial-gradient(var(--ink) 1.4px,transparent 1.5px);background-size:7px 7px;content:""}
.portfolio-kicker{margin:0 0 15px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em}
.portfolio-title{max-width:760px;margin:0;font-size:68px;font-weight:950;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.055em}
.portfolio-title em{color:var(--blue);font-style:normal}
.portfolio-note{max-width:570px;margin:22px 0 0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.7}
.portfolio-actions{display:grid;gap:10px;align-self:end}
.portfolio-action{display:flex;min-height:50px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 15px;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--paper);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);color:var(--ink);font-weight:900;text-decoration:none}
.portfolio-action:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.portfolio-action.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.category-heading{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin:0 0 16px}
.category-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:29px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.category-heading span{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em}
.category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;margin:0 0 42px}
.category-card{position:relative;display:flex;min-height:185px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden;padding:20px 21px;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.category-card:hover{transform:translate(-3px,-3px);box-shadow:8px 8px 0 var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.category-card:nth-child(2){background:#f3f0e7}
.category-card:nth-child(3){background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.category-card:nth-child(3):hover{color:#fff}
.category-index{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em}
.category-card h3{max-width:240px;margin:18px 0 5px;font-size:27px;font-weight:950;line-height:1.13;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.category-card p{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.category-arrow{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:16px;font-size:24px;font-weight:900}
.archive-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin:0 0 14px}
.archive-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:27px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.archive-heading span{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em}
.SideNav{gap:14px}
.SideNav-item{min-height:116px;padding:23px 25px!important;border:2px solid var(--ink)!important;border-radius:0!important;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.SideNav-item:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);border-color:var(--ink)!important;box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--ink)}
.SideNav-icon{border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.listTitle{font-size:20px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.listLabels .Label{border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;background:var(--paper)!important;color:var(--ink)!important;font-weight:900}
.listLabels .LabelTime{border:0;background:transparent!important}
#footer{border-top:3px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
body:has(#postBody){max-width:1000px}
body:has(#postBody) #header{align-items:center}
.postTitle{font-weight:950}
#postBody{padding:34px!important;border:3px solid var(--ink)!important;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--ink);line-height:1.9}
#postBody h2{border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
#postBody blockquote{border-left:5px solid var(--blue);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
#postBody pre{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:760px){body{padding:20px 18px 25px}.portfolio-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:23px;padding:27px 23px}.portfolio-hero:after{width:36px;height:36px}.portfolio-title{font-size:clamp(40px,12vw,62px)}.portfolio-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.category-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.category-card{min-height:145px}.category-card h3{font-size:25px}.category-heading{align-items:start;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.SideNav-item{min-height:105px}.listTitle{font-size:18px}#postBody{padding:22px!important}}

.portfolio-title{font-size:68px}.postTitle{font-size:42px!important}@media(max-width:760px){.portfolio-title{font-size:43px}}@media(max-width:430px){.portfolio-title{font-size:38px}}

/* Quiet paper background: fine registration grid, stipple and lunar orbits. */
:root{--paper:#e9e4ce;--texture-line:#25365409;--texture-dot:#25365416;--texture-glow:#ddc36a35}
html[data-color-mode=dark]{--paper:#151c2b;--texture-line:#b7c6ec08;--texture-dot:#b7c6ec12;--texture-glow:#bd9e3c0f}
html{min-height:100%;background-color:var(--paper);background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 0%,var(--texture-glow),transparent 65%),radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px,var(--texture-dot) .65px,transparent .9px),linear-gradient(var(--texture-line) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--texture-line) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:100% 100%,6px 6px,96px 96px,96px 96px}
body{position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-height:100vh;background:transparent}
body:before{position:fixed;z-index:-1;inset:0;pointer-events:none;content:"";background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 92% 24%,transparent 0 269px,var(--texture-dot) 270px 271px,transparent 272px 293px,var(--texture-line) 294px 295px,transparent 296px 353px,var(--texture-line) 354px 355px,transparent 356px),linear-gradient(125deg,transparent 0 76%,var(--texture-line) 76% 76.08%,transparent 76.15%)}

.about-portrait{width:100px;height:100px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #f5cc32}
.about-copy{min-width:0}
.about-eyebrow{margin:0 0 6px;color:#f5cc32;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em}
.about-copy>h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:32px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.2}
.about-tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid #101b36;border-bottom:0}
.about-tab{flex:1;min-width:70px;min-height:52px;padding:12px 18px;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.about-tab:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper)}
.about-tab[aria-selected=true]{color:#101b36;background:#f5cc32;border-bottom-color:#2449b8}
.about-tab:active{filter:brightness(.95)}
.about-panels{padding:28px 30px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid #101b36;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #101b36}
.about-content{font-size:16px;line-height:1.85;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-wrap:pretty}
.about-content>:first-child{margin-top:0}.about-content>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.about-content img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:520px;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain;margin:16px 0;border-radius:3px}
.about-content a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:underline}.about-profile a{color:#f5cc32}
.about-content pre{max-width:100%;overflow:auto;padding:16px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.about-content table{display:block;max-width:100%;overflow:auto}.about-content blockquote{margin-left:0;padding-left:18px;border-left:2px solid #f5cc32}
.about-panel{min-height:110px}.about-panel[hidden],.portfolio-home .SideNav-item[hidden]{display:none!important}
.about-status{margin:16px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:760px){.about-profile{grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;padding:23px 20px}.about-portrait{width:64px;height:64px}.about-copy>h3{font-size:27px}.about-tab{min-width:56px;padding:12px 6px;font-size:15px}.about-panels{padding:22px 20px}.about-content img{max-height:400px}}</style><script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const categories = [
    { label: "信息作品", number: "01", title: ["信息", "作品"], note: "设计、研究与可视化表达" },
    { label: "绘画作品", number: "02", title: ["绘画", "作品"], note: "插画、角色与视觉练习" },
    { label: "世界观作品", number: "03", title: ["世界观", "作品"], note: "设定、故事与原创世界" }
  ];
  const make = (tag, className, text) => {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (className) node.className = className;
    if (text) node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  };
  const home = document.querySelector("#content > .SideNav");
  const description = document.querySelector("#content > div:first-child");
  if (home && description && !document.querySelector(".tagTitle, #postBody, .portfolio-hero")) {
    document.body.classList.add("portfolio-home");
    const hero = make("section", "portfolio-hero");
    const copy = make("div");
    copy.append(make("p", "portfolio-kicker", "月夜档案 / MIDNIGHT WORKS"));
    const title = make("h1", "portfolio-title");
    title.append(document.createTextNode("把脑海里的东西，"));
    const accent = make("em", "", "把想象带到现实。");
    title.append(accent);
    copy.append(title);
    const intro = make("p", "portfolio-note", description.textContent.trim());
    copy.append(intro);
    const actions = make("div", "portfolio-actions");
    const browse = make("a", "portfolio-action", "浏览全部文章 ↗");
    browse.href = "tag.html#All";
    const aboutLink = make("a", "portfolio-action", "关于我 ↗");
    aboutLink.href = "#about-me";
    actions.append(browse, aboutLink);
    hero.append(copy, actions);

    const heading = make("div", "category-heading");
    heading.append(make("h2", "", "选择一个门类"));
    heading.append(make("span", "", "ARCHIVE / 03 CATEGORIES"));
    const grid = make("nav", "category-grid");
    grid.setAttribute("aria-label", "作品门类");
    categories.forEach(category => {
      const card = make("a", "category-card");
      card.href = "tag.html#" + encodeURIComponent(category.label);
      card.append(make("span", "category-index", "CATEGORY / " + category.number));
      const cardTitle = make("h3");
      cardTitle.append(make("span", "", category.title[0]), document.createElement("br"), make("span", "", category.title[1]));
      card.append(cardTitle, make("p", "", category.note));
      card.append(make("span", "category-arrow", "↗"));
      grid.append(card);
    });
    const archive = make("div", "archive-heading");
    archive.append(make("h2", "", "最近更新"));
    archive.append(make("span", "", "RECENT ENTRIES / 最近记录"));
    const about = make("section", "about-section");
    about.id = "about-me";
    about.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "about-heading");
    const aboutHeading = make("div", "category-heading");
    const aboutTitle = make("h2", "", "关于我");
    aboutTitle.id = "about-heading";
    aboutHeading.append(aboutTitle, make("span", "", "PERSONAL FILE / V1VY"));
    const profile = make("div", "about-profile");
    const avatar = document.querySelector(".avatar");
    if (avatar) {
      const portrait = avatar.cloneNode(true);
      portrait.removeAttribute("id");
      portrait.className = "about-portrait";
      portrait.alt = "V1VY 的头像";
      profile.append(portrait);
    }
    const bio = make("div", "about-copy");
    bio.append(make("p", "about-eyebrow", "BEHIND THE WORKS"), make("h3", "", "V1VY"));
    const bioContent = make("div", "about-content", "自我简介尚未填写。");
    bio.append(bioContent);
    profile.append(bio);
    const interests = ["游戏", "音乐", "影视", "漫画", "小说"];
    const tabs = make("div", "about-tabs");
    tabs.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
    tabs.setAttribute("aria-label", "我的兴趣");
    const panels = make("div", "about-panels");
    const destinations = new Map([["自我简介", bioContent]]);
    const buttons = [];
    const activate = index => {
      buttons.forEach((button, i) => {
        button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === index));
        button.tabIndex = i === index ? 0 : -1;
        destinations.get(interests[i]).hidden = i !== index;
      });
    };
    interests.forEach((label, index) => {
      const button = make("button", "about-tab", label);
      button.type = "button";
      button.id = "interest-tab-" + index;
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
      button.setAttribute("aria-controls", "interest-panel-" + index);
      const panel = make("div", "about-content about-panel", "还没有分享" + label + "相关的内容。");
      panel.id = "interest-panel-" + index;
      panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
      panel.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", button.id);
      panel.tabIndex = 0;
      buttons.push(button);
      destinations.set(label, panel);
      button.addEventListener("click", () => activate(index));
      button.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
        let next = index;
        if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (index + 1) % interests.length;
        else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (index + interests.length - 1) % interests.length;
        else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
        else if (event.key === "End") next = interests.length - 1;
        else return;
        event.preventDefault();
        activate(next);
        buttons[next].focus();
      });
      tabs.append(button);
      panels.append(panel);
    });
    activate(0);
    const status = make("p", "about-status", "正在读取个人档案…");
    status.setAttribute("role", "status");
    about.append(aboutHeading, profile, tabs, panels, status);
    description.before(hero, heading, grid, about, archive);
    description.hidden = true;

    // The personal file has its own space, outside the recent works list.
    home.querySelectorAll(".SideNav-item").forEach(item => {
      if (Array.from(item.querySelectorAll(".LabelName")).some(label => label.textContent.trim() === "关于我")) {
        item.hidden = true;
      }
    });

    const loadProfile = async () => {
      try {
        const indexResponse = await fetch("postList.json");
        if (!indexResponse.ok) throw new Error("Cannot load archive");
        const posts = await indexResponse.json();
        const entries = Object.entries(posts).filter(([key, post]) => /^P\d+$/.test(key) && post.labels?.includes("关于我"));
        entries.sort((a, b) => Number(b[0].slice(1)) - Number(a[0].slice(1)));
        if (!entries.length) {
          status.textContent = "个人档案，待续。";
          return;
        }
        const postUrl = new URL(entries[0][1].postUrl, location.href);
        if (postUrl.origin !== location.origin || !postUrl.pathname.includes("/post/")) throw new Error("Invalid profile URL");
        const response = await fetch(postUrl);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Cannot load profile");
        const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await response.text(), "text/html");
        const body = parsed.querySelector("#postBody");
        if (!body) throw new Error("Missing profile content");
        // Only keep passive Markdown content when embedding an article on the homepage.
        body.querySelectorAll("script,style,iframe,object,embed,form,input,button,svg,math,link,meta").forEach(node => node.remove());
        body.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(node => {
          for (const attribute of Array.from(node.attributes)) {
            if (!['href', 'src', 'alt', 'title', 'colspan', 'rowspan'].includes(attribute.name)) node.removeAttribute(attribute.name);
          }
          for (const name of ["href", "src"]) {
            if (!node.hasAttribute(name)) continue;
            try {
              const url = new URL(node.getAttribute(name), postUrl);
              if (!["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol)) node.removeAttribute(name);
              else node.setAttribute(name, url.href);
            } catch { node.removeAttribute(name); }
          }
          if (node.tagName === "IMG") { node.loading = "lazy"; node.decoding = "async"; }
        });
        let target = null;
        const filled = new Set();
        for (const node of Array.from(body.childNodes)) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.tagName === "H3" && destinations.has(node.textContent.trim())) {
            target = destinations.get(node.textContent.trim());
            target.replaceChildren();
            filled.add(target);
          } else if (target) {
            if (node.textContent.trim() === "_No response_" || node.textContent.trim() === "无响应") continue;
            target.append(node.cloneNode(true));
          }
        }
        destinations.forEach((target, label) => {
          if (!filled.has(target) || (!target.textContent.trim() && !target.querySelector("img"))) {
            target.textContent = label === "自我简介" ? "自我简介尚未填写。" : "还没有分享" + label + "相关的内容。";
          }
        });
        const full = make("a", "", "阅读完整个人档案 ↗");
        full.href = postUrl.href;
        status.replaceChildren(full);
      } catch {
        status.textContent = "个人档案暂时无法加载，请稍后刷新。";
      }
    };
    loadProfile();
  }

  const footer = document.querySelector("#footer");
  if (footer && !footer.querySelector(".site-credits")) {
    const credits = make("div", "site-credits");
    credits.append(make("span", "", "项目支持者："));
    const supporter = make("a", "", "ChatGPT");
    supporter.href = "https://chatgpt.com/";
    credits.append(supporter);
    const tools = make("details", "owner-tools");
    tools.append(make("summary", "", "站主工具"));
    const publish = make("a", "", "在 GitHub 发布作品 ↗");
    publish.href = "https://github.com/V1VYitar/V1VYitar.github.io/issues/new/choose";
    tools.append(publish);
    const editAbout = make("a", "", "管理关于我 ↗");
    editAbout.href = "https://github.com/V1VYitar/V1VYitar.github.io/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3A%E5%85%B3%E4%BA%8E%E6%88%91";
    const createAbout = make("a", "", "首次填写关于我 ↗");
    createAbout.href = "https://github.com/V1VYitar/V1VYitar.github.io/issues/new?template=04-about-me.yml";
    tools.append(editAbout, createAbout);
    footer.append(credits, tools);
  }

  const setCategoryTitle = () => {
    const tagTitle = document.querySelector(".tagTitle");
    if (!tagTitle) return;
    const category = categories.find(item => item.label === decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
    if (category && tagTitle.textContent.startsWith("Tag #")) {
      tagTitle.textContent = category.label;
      document.title = category.label + " - V1VY的作品集";
    }
  };
  setCategoryTitle();
  if (document.querySelector(".tagTitle")) {
    new MutationObserver(setCategoryTitle).observe(document.querySelector(".tagTitle"), {
      childList: true,
      characterData: true,
      subtree: true
    });
  }
});</script>

# 这里是V1VY！
今天我开通了我的第一个GitHub博客！在群友[L1rics](https://github.com/L1rics06)的协助下！
我正在学习美术（作为兴趣）！并且期望也能在代码界里做出些贡献！
我比较健忘和迟钝，对不起！
目前我连是否要读大学还是复读一年都不知道，不过我的第一个志愿就被录走了！是山东财经大学的大数据管理与应用！
我高中几年本最想考取的专业是网络安全，到考完等结果的期间更想读数媒技（艺）当技术美术，可惜高考失利让我都与之无缘！
说来，高三那年对我真是煎熬。
